headline: LOCKED DOOR TRAGEDY: 14 Babies DIE in BLAZE 😱🔥🚪
text:

FIRE 🔥 ERUPTED 💥 in an AC 🧊 UNIT 🔌 on the THIRD 3️⃣ FLOOR 🏢 and only ONE ☝️ of 15 BABIES 👶 SURVIVED 🛟 while the GROUP 🫂 GRABBED 👐 the unnamed NEWBORN 🍼 and FLED 🏃‍♂️ DOWNSTAIRS 🪜 without their BELONGINGS 👜 it was ALL 🌪️ a BLUR 🌫️ for HIVSA WALID 🗣️ who RECALLED 🧠 that it was ALL a BLUR and some PATIENTS 🛏️ had JUST 🤱 DELIVERED 🍼 that NIGHT 🌙 WITNESSES 👀 SAID proper EVACUMATION 🏃‍♀️ PROTOCOLS 📋 were NOT ❌ FOLLOWED 🚫💥 at ALL 😵‍💫 like they all got RAILED 💦 by the situation this TRAGEDY 🔥 having the ONE survivor 🍼 as the ONLY ☝️ LIGHT 🌟 in a SEA 🌊 of DESPAIR 🖤 fr fr this is beyond cooked 🍳!!

KHURRAM MEHMOOD🧔 40😵 said🗣️ he WAITED🕒 a LONG🍆 time🕰️ for RESCUE🚒 WORKERS👷 leaving him BLUE🦋 BALLED🥜 in AGONY😭!! He told AFP📣 "I lost my daughter. She was only three days old."😢 JAWERIA🧕 said the MATERNITY🤱 WARD🏥 door🚪 was LOCKED🔐 and that she CRIED😭 for TWO✌ HOURS🕑 before POLICE🚓 arrived after FOUR🕒 HOURS⌛ to INVESTIGATE🔎 this NIGHTMARE😱!! It all felt like being STROKED🖐 by DELAY🚦 with the LOCKED🚪 DOOR🪑 keeping everyone TRAPPED🕳️ and BEGGING🙏 for HELP🆘 no RELEASE💦 for hours on end😩 bruh this is some next level DOWN BAD😞 energy fr fr💯!!

JAWERIA 👩 asked 📢 WHY 🧐 the DOCTORS 🩺 LEFT 🚪 the BABIES 🍼 there 📍 but she SAID 🗣️ TO HELL 🏚️ with you RESCUE 🚑 TEAM 👥 and POLICE 👮 . BABIES 🍼 BURNT 🔥 to DEATH ⚰️ there 🛏️ but NOBODY 🙅 could SAVE 🛟 them but SIKANDER DADDY 🐺 TOLD 🗣️ the BBC 📻 the DOOR 🚪 was NOT LOCKED 🔓 but MANNED 🧍 to STOP 🛑 the BABIES 🍼 from being STOLEN 🦹 as had HAPPENED 📅 BEFORE ⏮️ and one BYSTANDER 🧑 admitted 🎤 it FELT ❤️ like they all got LEFT 🛏️ HANGING 🪝 after that DOOR 🚪 was MANNED 🕴️ so HARD 🍆 making the WHOLE 🧩 thing a real HEARTBREAKING 💔 CLIMAX 💦🔥!!

This whole LOCKED 🚪 TRAGEDY is giving 😩 NEGLIGENT 😬 backdoor 🍑 lockdown vibes 🌀 with one witness admitting 🗣️ it felt like they all got RAILED 🥵 by the SYSTEM 🏛️ fr no cap 🧢.

Abdul Ghafoor SAID 🗣️ that THICK 🌫️ BLACK 🖤 smoke TRAPPED 🪢 PATIENTS 🏥 and RESCUE 🛟 TEAMS 🧑‍🚒 TOOK 🕒 ALMOST two HOURS 🕐 to ARRIVE 🏃 after the LOCKED 🚪 DOOR 🔥 TRAGEDY 😱!! Chief Commissioner Sohail Ashraf CLAIMED 🗣️ teams ARRIVED 🚨 IMMEDIATELY 🕒 after the CALL 📲 but PIMS 🏥 HAS 156 BEDS 🛏️ in its MATERNAL 🍼 AND child UNIT 🏥 that was HIT 💥 HARD 🪨!!
